feedback: Approved to race. The candidate is valid and changes only kd, from 0.8 to 0.9, relative to iteration 4 (kp 2.6, base_speed 1.2, score 679.86). Geometry, ki 0.05, kp, base_speed, sensor_weights and line_loss are unchanged, so the race isolates derivative damping. Iteration 4 cut the slalom max_error from 0.0646 (iteration 3) to 0.0618, with line_loss_events down from 1.45 to 1.0, but it still ended 0/20 off track. The oval (20/20, mean 1.83 s) and s-bend (19/20, mean 2.13 s) show that speed is not the limit on those tracks. Because the slalom is 0.0018 m above the limit and it is the only track with no finishes, a small kd step is a low-risk test. Two cautions from history: kd 0.8 coincided with higher slalom line losses in iteration 3 (1.45 at kp 3.0, base_speed 1.3), and oval steering_oscillation was 0.14 at kd 0.8, so the jitter cost of kd 0.9 should be small. After the race, read the result by track. If the slalom max_error falls below 0.06 with any slalom finishes, hold kp 2.6, base_speed 1.2 and kd 0.9, and test ki 0.1 only if slalom line_loss_events stay at or above 1.0. If the slalom still ends off track with max_error at or above 0.06 and kd 0.9 does not reduce it, return kd to 0.8 and test kp 2.4 at base_speed 1.2. If the s-bend or oval finish rate drops below 0.95, return kd to 0.8. Keep geometry fixed until the slalom finishes at least once.
